name: Jakobsweg Via Regia 2
description_md:
Jakobsweg Via Regia 2 is an international waymarked hiking route located in Germany. The trail spans a distance of 79.7 km with 764 m of ascent and 828 m of descent.

This route belongs to the international waymarked hiking network. The difficulty is hard, which is derived from the distance and ascent. Hikers can expect a walking time of about 22 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
